description: This file defines the implementation of the CalcInput class and related functions for handling numeric input, including sign toggling, digit addition, decimal point management, exponent handling, and conversion to string and rational representations within a calculator engine.

classes.name: CalcInput
classes.description: Class managing numeric input, including sign, digits, decimal point, and exponent handling.

classes.name: CalcNumSec
classes.description: Class representing a numeric section, primarily used for the base and exponent parts of a number.

methods.name: CalcInput::Clear
methods.description: Resets the CalcInput object, clearing base and exponent parts and resetting flags.

methods.name: CalcInput::TryToggleSign
methods.description: Attempts to toggle the sign of the base or exponent, considering mode and bounds.

methods.name: CalcInput::TryAddDigit
methods.description: Attempts to add a digit to the base or exponent, respecting maximum length and special cases for radix and word size.

methods.name: CalcInput::TryAddDecimalPt
methods.description: Attempts to add a decimal point to the base number.

methods.name: CalcInput::HasDecimalPt
methods.description: Checks if the current number has a decimal point.

methods.name: CalcInput::TryBeginExponent
methods.description: Starts the exponent part of the number, adding a decimal point if necessary.

methods.name: CalcInput::Backspace
methods.description: Removes the last character from the base or exponent, handling flags and clearing parts if empty.

methods.name: CalcInput::SetDecimalSymbol
methods.description: Sets a new decimal symbol and updates the base number if decimal point exists.

methods.name: CalcInput::IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the input is empty.

methods.name: CalcInput::ToString
methods.description: Converts the current input to a string representation in the specified radix.

methods.name: CalcInput::ToRational
methods.description: Converts the current input to a Rational number considering radix and precision.
